meta.note: Rows transcribed verbatim from the official NFL.com Week-10 injury report as published on 2026-11-13. Practice Status and Game Status appear exactly as published; blank Game Status means the official page showed no designation yet (not an inference). Each player links the official NFL.com player page. Publication rule on the site: rows with an injury, a non-Full practice status, or a game designation are listed for every team; 49ers rows are always listed in full. Depth-chart tier (starter/2nd/3rd/4th string) is NOT published by the league report and is left blank unless an official team depth chart confirms it.

noInjuriesReported.note: The official report shows "No Injuries Reported" for both teams on the Monday Night Football game as of 2026-11-13.
